description: This file defines the TaxRateService interface providing methods for retrieving TaxRate objects based on various criteria such as store, country, zone, tax class, and language. It extends a generic entity service to support operations related to TaxRate management in a sales tax module.

classes.name: TaxRateService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing and retrieving TaxRate entities based on different filtering criteria.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRate objects associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves TaxRate objects filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves TaxRate objects based on country, state or province, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate object matching the specified code within a merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRate objects associated with a specific merchant store, filtered by language.
